newsitem.title: USA: Cabletron cuts price of enterprise switches.
newsitem.headline: Cabletron cuts price of enterprise switches.

text.p: Cabletron Systems Inc said it will unveil Tuesday a new module for its enterprise-class network switching system that provides switched and Fast Ethernet connections at a significantly lower price per connection.

The company said its new SmartModule would offer 24 ports, or connections, of switched Ethernet and four ports of Fast Ethernet connectivity, for use in high-density switched Ethernet workgroup settings.
It said its MMAC-Plus SmartSwitch for Ethernet and Fast Ethernet is list priced at $23,995. However, analysts said the street price was expected to run roughly half the list price.
With the new module, customers realize a reduction in configuration cost, the company said. Previously, backbone connections required a separate Fast Ethernet SmartSwitch module.

Esmerelda Silva, an analyst who follows the networking switch market for International Data Corp, said the price for the new system comes in at under $500 per port, or connnection, compared to the roughly $700 per port previously available from Cabletron.
Comparable backbone switches from other leading providers with this level of functionality run up to $1,500 per port, said Trent Waterhouse, a Cabletron marketing manager in its LAN switching unit.
